cohort: The study included 89 infants born to mothers with asthma participating in the Breathing for Life Trial (BLT).
finding: Higher eosinophil numbers in cord blood were associated with bronchiolitis hospitalisation in the first 12 months of life in infants born to asthmatic mothers.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was included as an adjustment factor in the logistic regression model but no specific findings related to mode of birth were reported.
